summary: A mixed day dominated by Reliance's Jio Platforms IPO plans and legal developments around judicial protests. Jio targets $106 billion valuation for October 21 IPO launch, while Supreme Court faces contempt plea over Delhi Metro station closures during CJP protests.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms targets $106 billion valuation in IPO planned for October 21 launch.
Supreme Court hears contempt plea alleging Delhi Metro stations closed despite court order during CJP protests.
Diageo India launches Smirnoff Ice ready-to-drink alcohol brand, competing against Bacardi in nascent segment.
Brent crude trades above $100 per barrel as Middle East supply risks sustain geopolitical premium over WTI.
UN trade body projects global economic growth to slow to 2.6% in 2026 amid Middle East energy shocks.
